- I tared the force sensor in free air above the platen, then lowered the probe onto the platen centre in 0.5 mm steps.

**Incident:** while moving between rim test points I sent a direct move without lifting the probe first, and the path hit the side of the platen. Afterwards the specimen measured the same (11.4 N/mm), but please inspect S-11 and the stand.
